final_announce: Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=device is ON if the sum of object numbers equals 4, or the set contains exactly one of the consecutive pairs (0,1), (2,3), (3,4), or (4,5) with no additional consecutive pairs
Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=the device turns on when object 4 is present and objects 3 and 5 are not.
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 4, object 7]; rule=object 1 must be present and objects 4 and 7 must not be present
Announce: relevant=[object 6, object 2, object 3]; rule=the device turns on if object 6 is present and neither object 2 nor object 3 is present
Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=object 3 must be present and neither object 4 nor object 5 may be present
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 6]; rule=the device turns on if object 0 is present and neither object 1 nor object 6 are included.
Announce: relevant=[object 4, object 5, object 7]; rule=the device turns on when object 4 is present and neither object 5 nor object 7 are present.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 6]; rule=the device turns on when object 4 is present and neither object 0 nor object 6 are present.

Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 3, object 4]; rule=the device is ON if (object 4 is present and objects 1 and 3 are absent) XOR (an odd number of objects from [object 1, object 3] are present and object 4 is absent)

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6]; rule=device turns on when exactly three objects are added (excluding object 7) and exactly one of their numeric indices is a prime number (2, 3, or 5)

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 6, object 7]; rule=the device turns on if object 1 is present (alone or with other relevant objects excluding 6/7) OR at least two of {0, 2, 6, 7} are placed with index sum ≥6 and not containing both 6 and 7
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 6]; rule=device turns on if exactly one of object 0 or object 4 is present and object 6 is not present
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2]; rule=object 0 must be present and objects 1 and 2 must not be present
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 4]; rule=object 0 must be present and objects 1 and 4 must not be present

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 6]; rule=the device turns on if exactly one of object 0, 1, or 6 is placed (with any other objects allowed), or if object 2 is placed with exactly one of object 0, 1, or 6 (with any other objects allowed)
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 4]; rule=the device turns on if exactly one object with a number that is a perfect square (0, 1, or 4) is placed on it, regardless of other objects.
